problem.text: The tensor diagnostic previously excluded only paths containing '.stderr.dbg.'. This change broadens that filter to include 'dbg.value_resolve_thread_list', consistent with the commit's reported PyCharm-debugger motivation.

reasoning.text: Filtering occurs inside collect, after tensor, device and size checks but before recording the reference. It suppresses matching diagnostic paths; it does not release tensors or prune the traversal queue.

impact.text: quantize.py imports list_gpu_tensors alongside free_mem, but the patch adds no invocation. A whole-parent-tree literal search found only the helper definition and its explanatory comment, not callers.

source_notes.text: The earlier cleanup entry describes the optional non-CUDA filter and per-device diagnostic tables; this change leaves those interfaces intact.
Issue #7, 'quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate', reports an extension import failure and a reporter-described environment workaround, not debugger references.

limitations: No live PyCharm session, tensor traversal or CUDA execution was tested. The parent-tree search found no literal PyCharm occurrence establishing debugger internals.
The Python check transcribed only the string predicate; it did not execute list_gpu_tensors. Literal caller searches do not exclude external or dynamic use.

chapters.title: Exclude additional debugger paths from tensor diagnostics

claims.text: list_gpu_tensors traverses globals, thread-frame locals, attributes, dictionary entries and sequences, collecting tensor references by object identity for size-sorted, per-device tables. The new any-substring predicate retains the existing exclusion and adds a second spelling.

Because exclusion is path-based rather than object-based, an otherwise reachable tensor can still be recorded through an unfiltered reference. The tradeoff is a narrow diagnostic-output filter rather than debugger-aware object detection.

A scalar predicate check preserved exclusion of the old stderr path, newly excluded worker.dbg.value_resolve_thread_list[0], and retained model.weight. A dictionary-form path containing dbg['value_resolve_thread_list'] did not match either substring, illustrating the filter's literal spelling boundary.

annotation.summary: Broadens tensor-diagnostic path filtering for debugger references and imports the helper into quantize.py without adding a call.
